kitDescription: Crow is a Fire SMG Defender whose Burst III, The Terrorist, is a single large hit (915.75% of final ATK) on the enemy with the highest final ATK, fired on her own cast before the Full Burst window opens. Her Skill 2, Daredevil, does two things each time her magazine runs dry: it lands a bonus hit on the target (89.09% of final ATK) and grants Crow a small self DEF buff (12.72% for 5 seconds). Her Skill 1, Killing Time, lowers all enemies' ATK by 19.93% for 10 seconds whenever the team enters Full Burst — a purely defensive debuff. She has no ally-facing buffs, no stacks, no weapon swap, and no damage over time.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas. Three of four kit lines (S2 rider, S2 DEF▲, burst nuke) are FAITHFUL and converged across all three independent derivations (S2b spec, S5 tests, S6 override — block-for-block identical to the driver), each with a discriminating counterfactual that is RED under its nearest-wrong model (per-shot rider, DEF-as-ATK, FB-entry nuke, level-1 magnitude). The fourth line (S1 enemy ATK▼) is a DOCUMENTED_GAP: the engine has no enemy-ATK channel (sim.ts:2295), the DEF=0 boss deals no damage, and the driver's C4 counterfactual proves that even enacting the line emits no buffApply and moves no total — it is inexpressible, not dropped, and recorded verbatim in unmodeled. The only divergence in the whole gauntlet is S5's three RED S1 assertions, which assume an encodability the engine does not have; S2b predicted exactly this misread and S6 independently ruled the same way as the driver, so it is classified as a blind-side recon error, not a finding. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the S1 ruling is load-bearing on the sim's no-boss-offense basis — if a boss-damage model is ever added, S1 must be revisited (already noted in caveats); and the rider's per-fight count rides the contested SMG 20/s cadence, which is base-stats-owned, not a kit-line issue.
